metaDescription: Order custom direct to film school spirit products for vibrant, durable designs. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today!
introHtml: Direct to film printing delivers high-opacity, full-color designs that bond permanently with fabric, making it ideal for custom school spirit apparel and accessories. Unlike screen printing, DTF works on polyester blends, nylon jackets, and even textured surfaces without cracking or peeling. Choose this method for detailed logos, mascots, or yearbook art on hoodies, rally towels, and stadium blankets that withstand repeated washings and game-day wear.
